title: Az orvosnál
intro: You have an appointment (időpont) at the GP's. The doctor calls you in.

a.speaker: Orvos
a.text: Jó napot! Foglaljon helyet. Mi a panasza?
a.textEn: Good afternoon! Take a seat. What's the problem?
a.textRo: Bună ziua! Luați loc. Ce probleme aveți?

choices.text: Jó napot! Fáj a fejem és a hasam.
choices.textEn: Hello! I have a headache and a stomach ache.
choices.textRo: Bună ziua! Mă doare capul și burta.

choices.note: Say what hurts: Fáj a fejem (my head hurts). The thing that hurts is the subject.

choices.text: A fejem és a hasam fáj.
choices.textEn: My head and my stomach hurt.

choices.note: "múlva" means "in (future) time". For "for two days (until now)" say két napja.

b2.speaker: Orvos
b2.text: Két nap múlva? Úgy érti, két napja?
b2.textEn: In two days? You mean for two days?
b2.textRo: Peste două zile? Vreți să spuneți de două zile?

c.speaker: Orvos
c.text: Rendben. Kérem, vegyen egy mély levegőt. Köszönöm.
c.textEn: All right. Please take a deep breath. Thank you.
c.textRo: Bine. Vă rog, respirați adânc. Mulțumesc.

d.speaker: Orvos
d.text: Nem súlyos, csak egy kis vírus. Pihenjen és igyon sok vizet. Írok egy igazolást is.
d.textEn: It's not serious, just a little virus. Rest and drink lots of water. I'll also write you a sick note.
d.textRo: Nu e grav, doar un mic virus. Odihniți-vă și beți multă apă. Vă scriu și o adeverință.
